question: What reaction occurs in step 6 of Total Synthesis of (-)-Glionitrin A/B? What reagents were involved in the reaction and what product was obtained? What was the yield obtained?
answer: In step 6 of Total Synthesis of (-)-Glionitrin A/B, a double bond hydroxylation reaction (R)-10a-((((R)-1-(4-Methoxyphenyl)ethyl)thio)-2-methyl-3-methylene-7-nitro-2,3,10,10,10a-tetrahydropyrazino[1,2-a]indole-1,4-dione (in article and SI number 32) occurred to give (3S, 10aR)-3-Hydroxy-3-(hydroxymethyl)-10a-(((R)-1- (4-methoxyphenyl)ethyl)thio)-2-methyl-7-nitro-2,3,10,10,10a-tetrahydropyrazino[1,2-a]indole-1,4-dione (trans isomer, in article number 33, in SI as trans-33) and (3R,10aR)-3-hydroxy-3-(hydroxymethyl)-10a-[(1R)-1-(4-methoxyphenyl)ethyl]sulfanyl-2-methyl-7-nitro-10H-pyrazino[1,2-a]indole-1,4-dione (cis-isomer, in SI as cis-33). The reaction was carried out with 0.1 equiv OsO4 dissolved in 2.5% tert-BuOH, 2.0 equiv NMO, 75:25 acetone and water, respectively, for 16 hours. The yield was 85 percent with a ratio of trans and cis diastereomers 87:13 respectively.
